original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, and HelmChart objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: The validator semvalidate.crd@v1 compared the install.yaml manifests for v2.6.4 [ev-782bc47d120d] and v2.7.0 [ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. It confirmed that status.artifact.digest exists in the HelmChart schema in both releases and only becomes required in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema. Because the change is specific to the v1 version, the crd-field subject correctly includes version v1. The change type now-required matches the computed diff, and the validator confirmed it.
